title: Ragna Crimson
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In a world ruled by the threat of dragons, the weak hunter Ragna partners with the gifted Leonica. After he meets his own future self and inherits power and memories of what is to come, he joins the scheming former Dragon Monarch Crimson in a war to wipe out the dragon Monarchs and prevent Leonica's death. A dark fantasy action series from Square Enix's Gangan.
life_message: Protecting the one you love can justify any sacrifice, though the cost of power and revenge is heavy.
